next.reason: 1985: "For an indexed file, the collating sequence associated with the native character set is assumed."; 2023: "If no COLLATING SEQUENCE clause is specified: a) ...native alphanumeric collating sequence; b) ...native national collating sequence". 1985 always assumes the native sequence for indexed keys. 2023 makes it only the default, which a COLLATING SEQUENCE clause can override, and adds a native national sequence for national keys.
